units.translation: about Darius: blessed king, equal in fortune to the gods
we arrived at the land of the Macedonians
having razed Troy with the mattock of Zeus who brings justice

not speaking a lengthy (μακεστῆρα in the copies) speech, but a concise one, which the scholiast explains as 'having length'. In many copies μακεστήρα, about which Hermann says: 'Lobeck in Paral. p. 451 leaves the reading undecided. The e might seem more in accordance with analogy, since we have μακεδνός, μακεσίκρανος. But the i is supported by the order of letters in Hesychius, who has: μακιστήρ: a missile, but it is also used for 'great'.'
I heard a lengthy speech of the heart, where Auratus restored μαστικτῆρα. Compare δ.ν. μάστειρα.
name of a mountain in Euboea, as it seems to Blomfield
hawks of doves, not far behind
one might speak of what one has accomplished; there is no need to speak at length
for you stretched it out at length
you stretched it out at length
or has this long-lived life appeared
the dative μακρῷ is used adverbially meaning 'far'
distant, far removed: on this meaning see Thes. vol. 5 p. 527
of distant time, ἐς μακράν is said, and with a negative οὐκ ἐς μακράν, i.e. soon: see Thes. vol. 5 p. 528
on the accusative μακράν used adverbially see under that word
the long life, where in the copies μακρόν χρόνον, which are often interchanged
to stretch out the long life
there is need of a long speech
these things need a long time (λόγου in the copies)
having completed a long length of time
rank called upon rank of the long ship
you have announced a great calamity in brief
the city does not love a long speech
art is far weaker than necessity
to marry within one's own rank is far best
may they grant me to obtain by far the best of my former entrances
whose distant colony, Io, it is fated for you and your children to found
In the verse of the interpolator Sept. 613 τείνουσι πομπὴν τὴν μακρὰν πόλιν μολεῖν, in the copies πάλιν seems rightly written for πόλιν, which is in M.
the longest flame of the furnace
(said of some little creature) long-legged indeed
